metadata.question: Is the tropospheric NO2 concentration higher in a region 50 km west of Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles, California than in a region 50 km southwest of Pacific Palisades on January 7, 2025 afternoon?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 L3: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2, date window 2025-01-07 to 2025-01-08, filtered to regions 50 km west and 50 km southwest of Pacific Palisades (center approx lon=-118.53, lat=34.05). Fallback to COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2, or widen date to 2025-01-06..2025-01-09.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask using cloud_fraction ≤ 0.3 if the band exists; otherwise no cloud mask.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 after recovery => C1.
- After masking, compute pixel counts; if 0 => C2.
- If mean is null or NaN => C3. Otherwise compare west > southwest to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.53, 34.05]); // Pacific Palisades approx
    const westPt = center.destination(50000, 270);      // 50 km west
    const swPt = center.destination(50000, 225);        // 50 km southwest
    const regionWest = westPt.buffer(10000);            // 10 km radius
    const regionSW = swPt.buffer(10000);

    const primaryStart = '2025-01-07';
    const primaryEnd = '2025-01-08';
    const widenStart = '2025-01-06';
    const widenEnd = '2025-01-09';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with recovery attempts
    function getCol(dataset, start, end, geom) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom);
    }

    let dataset = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2';
    let start = primaryStart;
    let end = primaryEnd;

    let col = getCol(dataset, start, end, center);
    let size = await col.size().getInfo();

    if (size === 0) {
      // Try NRTI same window
      const ds2 = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2';
      let col2 = getCol(ds2, start, end, center);
      let size2 = await col2.size().getInfo();
      if (size2 > 0) {
        dataset = ds2;
        col = col2;
        size = size2;
      } else {
        // Widen window with OFFL
        start = widenStart;
        end = widenEnd;
        let col3 = getCol('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2', start, end, center);
        let size3 = await col3.size().getInfo();
        if (size3 > 0) {
          dataset = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2';
          col = col3;
          size = size3;
        } else {
          console.log(`Dataset(s) empty for ${primaryStart}..${primaryEnd} (and widened ${widenStart}..${widenEnd}).`);
          console.log("C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location).");
          console.log("C1");
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: Cloud mask if available, then build NO2 image
    const firstBands = await ee.Image(col.first()).bandNames().getInfo();
    const hasCloudFrac = Array.isArray(firstBands) && firstBands.indexOf('cloud_fraction') !== -1;
    const bandName = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density';
    if (firstBands.indexOf(bandName) === -1) {
      console.log("Band missing: tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density");
      console.log("D");
      return;
    }

    let maskedCol = col;
    if (hasCloudFrac) {
      maskedCol = col.map(function(img) {
        const mask = img.select('cloud_fraction').lte(0.3);
        return img.updateMask(mask);
      });
    }

    const no2Img = maskedCol.select(bandName).median();

    // 4. Pixel counts to detect C2, and calculations
    const scale = 7000; // ~TROPOMI resolution, >= 3000 as required
    const countWest = await no2Img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: regionWest,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    const countSW = await no2Img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: regionSW,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    if (!countWest || !countSW || countWest === 0 || countSW === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Images: ${size} (${start}..${end})`);
      console.log(`West Pixels: ${countWest || 0}, SW Pixels: ${countSW || 0}`);
      console.log("C2: No Valid Pixels after masking/processing.");
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    const meanWest = await no2Img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: regionWest,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    const meanSW = await no2Img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: regionSW,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    if (meanWest === null || meanSW === null || isNaN(meanWest) || isNaN(meanSW)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Images: ${size} (${start}..${end})`);
      console.log(`Means invalid: West=${meanWest}, SW=${meanSW}`);
      console.log("C3: Calculation Failure (null/NaN).");
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // Optional cloud fraction stats
    let cfWest = null;
    let cfSW = null;
    if (hasCloudFrac) {
      const cfImg = col.median().select('cloud_fraction');
      cfWest = await cfImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: regionWest,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cloud_fraction').getInfo();

      cfSW = await cfImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: regionSW,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cloud_fraction').getInfo();
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Images: ${size} (${primaryStart} afternoon window: ${start}..${end})`);
    if (hasCloudFrac) {
      console.log(`CloudFrac (0-1) West: ${cfWest !== null ? cfWest.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}, SW: ${cfSW !== null ? cfSW.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    }
    console.log(`West Pixels: ${countWest}, Mean NO2 (mol/m^2): ${meanWest}`);
    console.log(`SW Pixels: ${countSW}, Mean NO2 (mol/m^2): ${meanSW}`);

    if (meanWest > meanSW) {
      console.log("A: Yes");
    } else {
      console.log("B: No");
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
